title: Keep every hospital handoff in view.
intro: Medi brings registration, care, diagnostic work, pharmacy and hospital administration into one shared staff workspace.
storyTitle: From arrival to the next handoff
arrivalBody: Keep patient identity separate from visits, orders and payments. Search the directory and continue an existing record.
careBody: Follow outpatient visits, nursing tasks, referrals and departmental work while preserving authorship and chronology.
operationsBody: Manage pharmacy stock, recorded cash or manual transfers, staff access and period reports.
securityTitle: A private workspace for your hospital
securityBody: Hospital-scoped access, role permissions and mandatory authenticator sign-in protect staff workflows. English and Amharic interface choices are independent from hospital calendar settings.
limits: Medi records cash and manual transfers. Live payment-provider integration is not available. Hospital clinical and operational acceptance is required before use with real patients.
footer: Built for independent hospitals and medical centers in Ethiopia.
